recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. Any change to uri search parameter type behavior or to make the invariant stronger than a warning should be handled as a separate work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-30697 was Published / Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked for CanonicalResource.url, plus resources inheriting that URL, to warn that canonical URLs should not contain unencoded '|' or '#'. It also requested canonical URL construction clarification and a wording cleanup in the canonical reference section.
initial_application: Commit 5c702608fa34803bf6ac3e88219d1774e50166f8 added cnl-1 to CanonicalResource.url and many then-current canonical resource URL elements. The canonical reference prose now shows {{CanonicalResource.url}}|{{CanonicalResource.version}} and uses corrected canonical URL reference wording, but later canonical/metadata refactoring left three current URL definitions without cnl-1.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2021-04-26 record the approved change as a warning invariant, so this reconciliation preserves warning severity and should-not wording. source/fhir.ini lists the edited resources as active, and an audit of CanonicalResource/MetadataResource StructureDefinitions found ObservationDefinition.url, SpecimenDefinition.url, and SubscriptionTopic.url as the only active URL declarations missing cnl-1.
reconciliation: Copied the existing cnl-1 warning constraint, including expression exists() implies matches('^[^|# ]+$') and CanonicalResource source declaration, to the three omitted current URL elements.

related_jiras.note: Nearby canonical reference wording cleanup helps explain why references.html did not need a new edit for FHIR-30697.
SubscriptionTopic later became a CanonicalResource, making its current URL element part of the inherited cnl-1 consistency check.

evidence_items.summary: Published / Persuasive with Modification issue about uri search parameters versus canonical URL references.
evidence_items.learned: The final request was to add a CanonicalResource.url invariant against unencoded pipe and hash characters and clarify canonical URL construction.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I minutes say to add a warning invariant to CanonicalResource.url that url should not have '|' or '#'.
evidence_items.learned: The work-group record supports preserving warning severity and should-not wording.

evidence_items.summary: Initial FHIR-30697 commit added cnl-1 to CanonicalResource and many canonical resource StructureDefinitions.

evidence_items.learned: The reconciliation covers the bounded omission set without broad unrelated edits.
